title: OLIVER BAAZ: THE NEON CITY SHOWDOWN | Official Animated Short Film
original_title: OLIVER BAAZ: THE NEON CITY SHOWDOWN | Official Animated Short Film
overview: Directed and created by Sanjay Rao (professionally known as Oliver Baaz), "The Neon City Showdown" is a high-octane animated short film. In the glowing streets of a futuristic metropolis, the legendary hero Oliver Baaz faces an intense battle against a powerful robotic threat to protect the city.
